title_fa: بررسیِ تلفظِ صدا (Piper + تشخیص گفتار) برای صفحهٔ «تلفظ»
note: The pronunciation check speaks a fixed set of Persian sentences (plain, and after the site's pronunciation layer) and listens to them with faster-whisper (feature asr-gpu). Piper (piper-tts 1.8.0, MIT, its own environment venvs/pron; ONNX on the CPU is faster than real time) and TWO Persian Piper voices - the same fa_IR-amir-medium and fa_IR-gyro-medium voices the site already narrates with (rhasspy/piper-voices, MIT; trained on CC0 data) - are installed here, visibly, with sizes and sha256, so the node can run the phoneme path the site uses. Nothing replaces or modifies any voice model; MOSS-TTS is used through the node's own audio service. Mirror order: hf-mirror.com, then huggingface.co.
